summary: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. (Nasdaq: LEXX) filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 detailing Inducement Letters dated September 7, 2026 with certain holders of existing common stock purchase warrants originally issued February 2024 ($32.78 strike), October 2024 ($45.90), September 2025 ($20.55) and December 2025 ($17.85). Holders immediately exercised warrants for up to 453,969 shares at a reduced price of $12.92 per share, generating roughly $5.9 million in gross proceeds before placement agent fees and expenses. The company issued Series A warrants for 453,969 shares at $12.67, exercisable five years, and Series B warrants for 453,969 shares at $12.67, exercisable eighteen months. A 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation applies, adjustable to 9.99% with 61 days notice. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch the overhang from newly issued warrants and the actual cash received net of fees as potential dilution pressures the stock.
